categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet database records, descriptor management, and wallet RPCs across src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Retaining multipath descriptors enables hardware wallet integrators like HWI to register multisig wallets under BIP 388 for safe on-device address verification. As noted in the PR description, hardware wallets require unified multipath descriptors for the 'registerdescriptor' command to safely verify receive and change addresses, solving an integration bottleneck where Core previously discarded the multipath association upon import or creation.
